t: The Titan TTI1201GGT 18V Li-Ion TXP Brushless Cordless Grass Trimmer is a robust garden tool designed for efficient lawn maintenance and precise edging. Its powerful 18V brushless motor and 5.0Ah battery deliver strong cutting performance, ideal for professional landscapers and dedicated gardeners tackling overgrown areas or maintaining large estates. With a 30cm cutting width, this versatile cordless trimmer easily navigates paths, borders, and tougher spots. The integrated edging facility ensures neat finishes, while the pivoting head and telescopic shaft allow effortless trimming under garden furniture and around delicate plants, protected by the convenient plant guard.
b: Up to 250m² Cutting Coverage on One Charge of 5.0Ah Battery
